remote.label: Connect to PC
remote.title: Connect to my PC
remote.intro: Connect to your PC to see what you're studying there, and the PC's CLI answers your questions. You can also use it on this device with an API key, without a PC.
remote.step1: Open the octobooks app on your PC and turn on [Open remote pairing] under Settings → Connections.
remote.step2: Press [Connect phone or web] to show a QR code and a 6-digit code.
remote.step3: Below, scan the QR or enter the link, or the address and code.
remote.storeNote: Study records are saved on your PC

local.label: Get started
local.choosePitch: The further your curiosity reaches, the deeper your learning goes. Open a new branch from a question in a reply. First, connect the AI you'll learn with.
local.cliDesc: Runs the installed and signed-in Claude Code or Codex CLI as is. You can also choose the model and effort.
local.apiDesc: Calls directly with an Anthropic or OpenAI API key.
local.remoteTip: To use this PC's CLI from your phone or the web, connect, then turn on Settings → Connections → [Open remote pairing].
local.apiNote: Studies are saved on this device, and answers come through the API key you registered.
